issues.what: Loop cycles 'Talking costs time' defines a 'fractional time-spend verb', but Clock 2, the decision record (R1) and config.yaml define elapsedWatches as a monotonic INTEGER advanced only by advance_watches. An implementer of 05b-1 cannot tell whether advance_watches takes fractions, whether a sub-watch remainder exists, or what a 'fractional' charge does to autosave-at-watch-boundary.
issues.fix: State one model in the decision record: either talk cost is an integer watch count (e.g. 1 per conversation), or advance_watches takes a whole number and a sub-watch remainder accumulates on WorldState and carries over. Then reword Loop cycles to match. Needs an owner call; do not leave 'fractional' unreconciled.

issues.what: Section 10 ('A conversation' bullet, ~line 433) still says 'Reading costs no watch.' The Loop cycles section says talk now charges one fractional spend and 'replaces' that sentence, but the sentence was left in place. An agent reading section 10 alone gets the old rule. The section 10 status banner already mentions the talk cost, so the body now disagrees with its own banner.
issues.fix: Edit the sentence to: 'Reading one chunk costs no watch; the conversation as a whole is charged once (see Loop cycles).' Remove the 'replaces' phrasing from Loop cycles so it does not point at deleted text.

issues.what: Section 0 Clock 1 bullet (~line 258) says Clock 1 'Never advances macro calendar watches' and lists 'live conversation' as Clock 1 work. Talking now charges a time-spend, and the Loop cycles minute-cycle bullet says 'Nothing in the minute cycle advances a campaign watch by itself' directly above the talk charge. Contradictory unless read as 'by itself'.
issues.fix: Add 'except the one per-conversation time-spend charge (Loop cycles)' to the Clock 1 bullet, and make the minute-cycle bullet say the talk charge is the only exception.

issues.what: Section 0 Clock 2 prose (~line 259) says 'Change 05b rebates Change 03's ... fields'. The id 05b no longer exists (split to 05b-1 / 05b-2-*), and the decision record now says 'renamed *Watches while it has no users', not 'rebased onto' by a change. Old 4-clock prose and the record say the same thing in two different vocabularies. config.yaml Clock 2 bullet is already updated; DESIGN_NOTES is not.
issues.fix: Replace 'Change `05b` rebates ... onto Watches' with 'renamed to *Watches in 05b-1-watch-clock-and-time-spend (see the decision record)'. Do not restate the field list twice.

issues.what: Sections 7 and 8 mix shipped facts and planned design in the same present tense under a one-line 'read each verb as will' note ('The shipped hinge yaws that centered leaf', 'the existing paused bit', 'requestSetPortalState', 'the existing prop-state effect', 'selectProximityTarget is a pure function'). The note makes the banner safe for the section as a whole, but an agent cannot tell which individual sentences are already in code. Sections 9 to 11 have no such mix, so the one-line note is enough there. Sub-sections 10a to 10e carry only a heading marker, no banner.
issues.fix: In 7 and 8, tag each shipped reference inline with '(shipped)' and keep the rest as planned. Optionally add a one-line 'Status: planned, see section 10' under 10a to 10e, or one shared banner after the 10 heading that covers 10a to 10e.
